offering_description.value: Digi sells networking equipment, embedded wireless modules, and device management software to equipment makers, enterprises, and public agencies. It designs hardware and software for connecting and managing remote equipment and provides managed connectivity and monitoring through cloud platforms.

primary_products.value: Industrial routers and gateways; embedded wireless and computing modules; console servers; connected sensors; device management software

primary_services.value: Managed network connectivity; remote infrastructure management; temperature and condition monitoring; wireless design and integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Equipment manufacturers, network operators, industrial companies, food retailers, restaurant chains, and healthcare organizations; B2G: Public transit and other government agencies that operate connected infrastructure

end_markets.value: Telecommunications and data centers; manufacturing and utilities; transportation; food retail and foodservice; healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: Routers, gateways, console servers, embedded modules, and sensors; subscription: Cloud device management, managed network connectivity, and remote monitoring; service fees: Wireless design and integration services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Designs networking and monitoring devices from electronic components for enterprises and public agencies; component supplier: Supplies embedded wireless and computing modules to equipment manufacturers; software / platform: Processes connected-device data for enterprise device management and monitoring; service provider: Uses carrier networks and connected devices to manage connectivity and monitoring for enterprises
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Embedded wireless, industrial networking, remote infrastructure management, managed connectivity, and condition monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving equipment makers, enterprises, and public agencies; distributors / dealers: Electronics component and networking equipment distributors; partners / resellers: Value-added resellers and systems integrators
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Wireless equipment is subject to FCC authorization and EU Radio Equipment Directive requirements.
